And the master of the hut takes the cold, hungry, stinking, ragged, dirty man, and not merely gives him a night's lodging, but feeds him as well.

arxiv-1804-06455.title: MultiMesh Finite Elements with Flexible Mesh Sizes
arxiv-1804-06455.creator: August Johansson, Mats G. Larson, Anders Logg
arxiv-1804-06455.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by August Johansson, Mats G. Larson, Anders Logg. We analyze a new framework for expressing finite element methods on arbitrarily many intersecting meshes: multimesh finite element methods. The multimesh finite element method, first presented in [ 40 ] , enables the use of separate meshes to discretize parts of a computational domain that are naturally separate; such as the components of an engine, the domains of a multiphysics problem, or solid bodies interacting under the influence of forces from surrounding fluids or other physical fields.

arxiv-2102-06624.title: A Generative Model for Hallucinating Diverse Versions of Super Resolution Images
arxiv-2102-06624.creator: Mohamed Abid, Ihsen Hedhli, Christian Gagné
arxiv-2102-06624.description: Abstract Traditionally, the main focus of image super-resolution techniques is on recovering the most likely high-quality images from low-quality images, using a one-to-one low- to high-resolution mapping. Proceeding that way, we ignore the fact that there are generally many valid versions of high-resolution images that map to a given low-resolution image.

arxiv-2104-02617.title: Are GAN generated images easy to detect? A critical analysis of the state-of-the-art
arxiv-2104-02617.description: Abstract The advent of deep learning has brought a significant improvement in the quality of generated media. However, with the increased level of photorealism, synthetic media are becoming hardly distinguishable from real ones, raising serious concerns about the spread of fake or manipulated information over the Internet.

arxiv-2108-12847.title: Non-Parametric Neural Style Transfer
arxiv-2108-12847.creator: Nicholas Isaac Kolkin
arxiv-2108-12847.description: Abstract It seems easy to imagine a photograph of the Eiffel Tower painted in the style of Vincent van Gogh’s ’The Starry Night’, but upon introspection it is difficult to precisely define what this would entail. What visual elements must an image contain to represent the ’content’ of the Eiffel Tower?

arxiv-2302-06561.title: Gait design for limbless obstacle aided locomotion using geometric mechanics
arxiv-2302-06561.creator: Baxi Chong 1 , Tianyu Wang 2 , Daniel Irvine 3 , Velin Kojouharov 2 , Bo Lin 3 , Howie Choset 4 , Daniel I. Goldman 1 , and Grigoriy Blekherman 3
arxiv-2302-06561.description: Abstract Limbless robots have the potential to maneuver through cluttered environments that conventional robots cannot traverse. As illustrated in their biological counterparts such as snakes and nematodes, limbless locomotors can benefit from interactions with obstacles, yet such obstacle-aided locomotion (OAL) requires properly coordinated high-level self-deformation patterns (gait templates) as well as low-level body adaptation to environments.

arxiv-2411-18998.title: Optimal control applied to viral competition corresponding author, email: alberto.perez.munuzuri@usc.es
arxiv-2411-18998.creator: Javier López-Pedrares, Cristiana J. Silva, M. Elena Vázquez-Cendón, Alberto P. Muñuzuri
arxiv-2411-18998.description: Abstract The emergence of mutant lineages within a viral species has become a public health problem, as the existing treatments and drugs are usually more effective on the original lineages than in the mutant ones. The following manuscript presents mathematical models that describe the emergence of these lineages.

arxiv-2506-01566.title: FlexiSAGA: A Flexible Systolic Array GEMM Accelerator for Sparse and Dense Processing
arxiv-2506-01566.creator: Mika Markus Müller *, Konstantin Lübeck *, Alexander Louis-Ferdinand Jung, Jannik Steinmetz, Oliver Bringmann
arxiv-2506-01566.description: Abstract Artificial Intelligence (AI) algorithms, such as Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), have become an important tool for a wide range of applications, from computer vision to natural language processing. However, the computational complexity of DNN inference poses a significant challenge, particularly for processing on resource-constrained edge devices.

arxiv-2512-11245.title: Breast-Rehab: A Postoperative Breast Cancer Rehabilitation Training Assessment System Based on Human Action Recognition
arxiv-2512-11245.creator: Zikang Chen, Tan Xie, Qinchuan Wang, Heming Zheng, Xudong Lu
arxiv-2512-11245.description: Abstract Postoperative upper limb dysfunction is prevalent among breast cancer survivors, yet their adherence to at-home rehabilitation exercises is low amidst limited nursing resources. The hardware overhead of commonly adopted VR-based mHealth solutions further hinders their widespread clinical application. Therefore, we developed Breast-Rehab, a novel, low-cost mHealth system to provide patients with out-of-hospital upper limb rehabilitation management.

arxiv-2601-02624.title: This paper will be presented at Design, Automation and Test in Europe Conference (DATE) 2026 LAsset: An L LM-assisted Security Asset Identification Framework for System-on-Chip (SoC) Verification
arxiv-2601-02624.creator: Md Ajoad Hasan, Dipayan Saha, Khan Thamid Hasan, Nashmin Alam, Azim Uddin, Sujan Kumar Saha, Mark Tehranipoor, Farimah Farahmandi
arxiv-2601-02624.description: Abstract The growing complexity of modern system-on-chip (SoC) and IP designs is making security assurance difficult day by day. One of the fundamental steps in the pre-silicon security verification of a hardware design is the identification of security assets, as it substantially influences downstream security verification tasks, such as threat modeling, security property generation, and vulnerability detection.

pmc-10743175.title: Unlocking the Potential of Microwave Sterilization Technology in Ready-to-Eat Imitation Crab Meat Production
pmc-10743175.creator: Qianqian Xue, Changhu Xue, Donglei Luan, Yajing Wang, Yunqi Wen, Shijie Bi, Lili Xu, Xiaoming Jiang, Robert L Buchanan
pmc-10743175.description: Microwave sterilization is a novel potential sterilization technology to improve food quality. An industrial microwave sterilization system was used to sterilize imitation crab meat under thermal processing intensity F0 = 1, 2, 3. The characteristics of the microwave process, such as heating rate, processing time, and C100, were calculated. In addition, the quality of processed imitation crab meat was investigated.

pmc-11481568.title: Combating wheat yellow mosaic virus through microbial interactions and hormone pathway modulations
pmc-11481568.creator: Fangyan Wang, Haoqing Zhang, Hongwei Liu, Chuanfa Wu, Yi Wan, Lifei Zhu, Jian Yang, Peng Cai, Jianping Chen, Tida Ge
pmc-11481568.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThe rhizosphere microbiome is critical for promoting plant growth and mitigating soil-borne pathogens. However, its role in fighting soil-borne virus-induced diseases, such as wheat yellow mosaic virus (WYMV) transmitted by Polymyxa graminis zoospores, remains largely underexplored. In this study, we hypothesized that during viral infections, plant microbiomes engage in critical interactions with plants, with key microbes playing vital roles in maintaining plant health.

pmc-12425495.title: RNA‐binding proteins orchestrating immunity in plants
pmc-12425495.creator: Marcel Bach‐Pages, Athira Menon, Brett Wadley, Alfredo Castello, Gail M. Preston
pmc-12425495.description: SUMMARYRNA‐binding proteins (RBPs) direct the function and fate of RNA throughout the RNA lifecycle and play important roles in plant immunity, orchestrating the post‐transcriptional reprogramming of the transcriptome following induction of plant immune responses, a process that we term ‘RBP‐mediated immunity’.

pmc-12526651.title: CoCoChain: A Concept-Aware Consensus Protocol for Secure Sensor Data Exchange in Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks
pmc-12526651.creator: Rubén Juárez, Ruben Nicolas-Sans, José Fernández Tamames
pmc-12526651.description: Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks (VANETs) support safety-critical and traffic-optimization applications through low-latency, reliable V2X communication. However, securing integrity and auditability with blockchain is challenging because conventional BFT-style consensus incurs high message overhead and latency. We introduce CoCoChain, a concept-aware consensus mechanism tailored to VANETs.

pmc-12784091.title: Early-life obesity as a risk factor for central precocious puberty – A commentary on "Incidence of central precocious puberty and the role of body mass index in Korea"
pmc-12784091.creator: Hae Sang Lee
pmc-12784091.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). n CPP incidence and examining the relationship between early childhood obesity and pubertal onset in Korea. Compared with 2012, the incidence of CPP increased substantially by 2020 in both sexes. Importantly, higher degrees of obesity between ages 2 and 6 years were significantly associated with an increased risk of CPP, with this association being more pronounced in boys than in girls [3]. Previous studies have consistently shown that the incidence of CPP has increased over time in countries worldwide.

pmc-12785607.title: Opportunistic Bone Health Assessment Using Contrast-Enhanced Abdominal CT: A DXA-Referenced Analysis in Liver Transplant Recipients
pmc-12785607.creator: Nurullah Dag, Hilal Er Ulubaba, Sevgi Tasolar, Mehmet Candur, Sami Akbulut
pmc-12785607.description: Objective: This study aimed to investigate the relationship between computed tomography (CT)-derived Hounsfield Unit (HU) measurements and dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA) and to evaluate the feasibility of using contrast-enhanced abdominal CT as a complementary tool in the assessment of bone health in liver transplant recipients.

pmc-13164667.title: Microwave-Sintered Lunar Regolith Bricks for Lunar Infrastructure: Fracture Behavior, Tribological Performance, and Electromagnetic Wave Transmission
pmc-13164667.creator: Kelei Zhu, Juntao Guo, Qiqi Ning, Zhaobo Han, Longxiang Xu, Zhen Liu, Bo Gao, Jinping Li
pmc-13164667.description: Microwave-sintered lunar regolith bricks are promising candidates for in situ construction of lunar infrastructure, where structural load-bearing capacity and multifunctional performance are simultaneously required. Currently, there remains a research gap concerning the service performance of microwave-sintered lunar soil bricks under predictable load-bearing, wave-transparent, and friction working conditions.

pmc-13222888.title: Ranking land degradation drivers in eastern Inner Mongolia using partial order theory and Hasse diagram analysis
pmc-13222888.creator: Kaixin Liu, Batunacun, Yong Mei, Yu Feng, Ruifang Guo, Chang An, Yaxin Wang, Bin Sun
pmc-13222888.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Land degradation (LD) poses a major challenge to global sustainable development, with the attainment of land degradation neutrality recognised as a key indicator of Sustainable Development Goal 15.3 (SDG 15.3). This goal focuses on combating desertification, restoring degraded land and soil, and including land affected by desertification, drought, and floods, with the aim of creating a land degradation-neutral world by 2030. Eastern Inner Mongolia (EIM), a typical agro-pastoral transitional zone, has experienced increasingly severe LD in recent decades.

pmc-13325341.creator: Watcharapong Wararam, Manasbodin Asava-arunotai, Kulanit Lanamkham, Angsuthorn Ngamprasit, Sira Sripirommit, Thura Lin Htet, Tanyakorn Muangnapoh, Krissada Surawathanawises, Gasidit Panomsuwan, Anusorn Seubsai, Kulpavee Jitapunkul, Oratai Jongprateep

pmc-13326649.title: Development and prognostic evaluation of a combined SII–LNR score in resectable gastric and gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma treated with perioperative FLOT: a retrospective single-center study
pmc-13326649.creator: Mert Tohumcuoğlu, Mahmut Büyükşimşek
pmc-13326649.description: BackgroundThe systemic immune-inflammation index (SII) and lymph node ratio (LNR) have both been associated with survival in gastric and gastroesophageal junction (GEJ) adenocarcinoma, but their combined prognostic value is unclear in patients treated with perioperative fluorouracil, leucovorin, oxaliplatin, and docetaxel (FLOT). We developed a combined SII–LNR risk score and assessed its association with overall survival (OS) and disease-free survival (DFS).

pmc-13463131.title: Selective Anti‐Inflammatory Actions of Curcumin on Cytokine Pathways in Major Depressive Disorder
pmc-13463131.creator: Tangcong Chen, Yueyang Luo, Mengqi Niu, Jing Li, Mengdie Li, Yingqian Zhang, Michael Maes

pmc-13584153.title: Bridging the Resolution Gap in Recurrent Prostate Cancer Imaging: Quantum Dots as PSMA-Targeted Optical Probes
pmc-13584153.creator: Yugmee Gidiya, Jiya Chaudhary, Annafew Biswas, Mandy Liao, Marine Ramaroson, Ken-ichiro Kamei
pmc-13584153.description: Recurrent prostate cancer (RPC) remains a major clinical challenge driven by residual and disseminated tumor cells exhibiting pronounced molecular and spatial heterogeneity. Prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA)-targeted positron emission tomography enables sensitive whole-body detection of recurrent lesions; however, its millimeter-scale spatial resolution and limited multiplexing capacity constrain the characterization of cellular heterogeneity and micrometastatic disease.

pmc-13628037.title: Retrieve-Then-Verify for Evaluating Evidence Support and Hallucination in Large Language Model–Generated Medical Information: Empirical Study
pmc-13628037.creator: Zhaohui Liang, Cynthia Sheffield, Gisela Butera, Sameer Antani, Ivan Steenstra, Pei-fu Chen, Cynthia Lokker, Yi Xin
pmc-13628037.description: BackgroundDespite high reported accuracy on clinical and evidence appraisal tasks, AI-generated medical information may lack explicit support from source documents. This creates challenges for digital health practitioners regarding transparency, auditability, and trust when AI systems are used for evidence synthesis, guideline development, and clinical knowledge management.
